properties.displayName: SCF - Manual attestation for ensuring Cloud Security Controls Comply with Regulatory and Industry Standards
properties.description: This policy requires manual attestation to confirm that controls align with laws (e.g., MAS, RMIT, OJK) and are reviewed regularly. Regulatory and security requirements must be updated and complied with at all times. Perform regular cloud security assessments, remediate risks promptly, and maintain controls aligning with PCI DSS and regulatory obligations.
